senses.gloss:
ह्वे ह्वे, i. 1, Par. Ātm. (in the Vedas also हू हू),
 1. To call, Rām. 2, 34, 11; Chr. 289, 4 = Rigv. i. 49, 4 (अहूषत, ved. aor.); Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14 (जुहूरे, ved. red. pf.).
 2. To name, Kumāras. 1, 26.
 3. To invoke, MBh. 1, 4944.
 4. To challenge, to vie with (with acc.), MBh. 3, 1823 (शशिनं ह्वयन्ती, Vying with the moon).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. हूत, Summoned, invited.
 --Comp.
 --With आ आ,
 I. Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 91, 12).
 1. To call, Rām. 2, 58, 1.
 2. To invoke, Rām. 2, 91, 12; Lass. 101, 3 = Rigv. vii. 16, 1 (आ हुवे, ved. pres.); Lass. 101, 7 = Rigv. vii. 16, 3 (आ जुह्वान, ptcple. pf. pass.).
 3. To invite, Man. 3, 27. []
 4. To convoke, Hit. 82, 16.
 II. Ātm.
 1. To challenge, MBh. 2, 879; Chr. 26, 74 (आह्वयाम् आस, anomal. pf.), 37, 10 (आह्वयान, anomal. ptcple. pres.).
 2. To emulate.
 --Caus. ह्वायय, To order to call, Rām. 2, 89, 3.
 --With उपा उप-आ, Ātm. To challenge, MBh. 2, 1785.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To convoke, Pañc. 82, 6; Rām. 1, 8, 18.
 2. To call, Pañc. 210, 10; MBh. 3, 8549.
 3. To challenge, MBh. 2, 1518. समाहूत, [] Convoked, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 19.
 --With नि नि, To call down (from heaven), Chr. 298, 24 = Rigv. i. 112, 24.
 --With प्र प्र, To call, Utt. Rāmac. 146, 2.
 --Cf. O.H.G. hweion; Goth. vôpjan (probably the regular Caus.); A.S. hweóp (cry, called out), and wepan; probably also cygan (3. conj., cl. जुहू); βοή, βοάω, probably ἀΰω and ἰωή; Lat. re-boare, and perhaps vovere, vōtum.
